extDescription.message: Sends YouTube/YouTube Music cookies to the LFMusic app for more reliable track downloads.

desc.message: Make sure you're signed in to YouTube in this browser, then send the current session to the LFMusic app.

footnote.message: Cookies are sent only to 127.0.0.1 — straight into the LFMusic app, nowhere else.

statusSuccess.message: Session sent. Switch back to LFMusic.

errorNoCookies.message: No YouTube Music cookies found in this browser.

errorNoAuthCookies.message: No sign-in cookies found — sign in to YouTube in this browser.

errorNoResponse.message: LFMusic didn't respond. Make sure the app is running.
